modes.label: Plan
modes.hint: Plan: read-only. Commands are refused; files can still be read
modes.denyNote: Plan mode (read-only): commands are not run. Switch the conversation to Ask or Auto to execute.

modes.label: Read-only
modes.summary: only read-only commands run; writes are refused
modes.hint: Read-only: listings and read-only git run on their own. Any command that could write is refused, with the reason shown
modes.denyNote: Read-only preset: only read-only commands run. This one could change files or cannot be checked, so it was not run. Switch to Ask or Workspace write to approve it yourself.

modes.label: Ask
modes.hint: Ask: every command waits for your approval
modes.denyNote: Not allowed by the permission mode.

modes.label: Auto
modes.summary: read-only commands run on their own
modes.hint: Auto: read-only git and listings run without asking. In a trusted workspace it also runs the project's own scripts (npm, pytest) without asking. Everything else asks
modes.denyNote: Not allowed by the permission mode.

modes.label: Workspace write
modes.summary: writes inside the workspace run on their own; anything else asks
modes.hint: Workspace write: file commands whose paths all stay inside the workspace run without asking. A write outside the workspace, or any command Nilo cannot check, asks for your approval
modes.denyNote: Not allowed by the permission mode.

modes.label: Full
modes.summary: commands run without asking, except high-risk ones
modes.hint: Full: commands run without asking, inside and outside the workspace. High-risk commands, and commands that name a secret file, still ask. Choose it only for work you are watching
modes.denyNote: Not allowed by the permission mode.
